summary.title: Restore Codex history and deliver Sherlog v0.5.4
summary.what: Recover recent Codex user/assistant messages and stale projections, stabilize paginated append identities, pair mirrored encodings, and ship v0.5.4 through GitHub Release, Homebrew, sherlog.net and the local installed CLI and skill.
summary.why: The original need in int_28bb460b was missing recent conversations. Review int_d7efcb7b showed that only accepting a new record type leaves old EOF cursors, paginated appends and duplicate mirrors incorrect. The implementation makes recovery automatic through the existing scoped sync workflow.
summary.user_goal: 可靠恢复 Codex 对话检索并发布，更新文档官网和本机

decisions.chose: One adapter-owned accepted-v3 marker drives both inventory cache and serialized reducer invalidation. A valid empty reducer can append its first message.
decisions.rationale: This replays both empty and nonempty old projections and avoids treating message counts as parser version evidence.

decisions.chose: Persist the base session identity; derive the public segment ID separately and preserve fallback filename stems during cold retention.
decisions.rationale: Repeated session_meta and later appends must resolve to the same stored segment without overwriting the parent.

decisions.chose: Pair adjacent accepted same-role exact-text records only across opposite encodings, keeping checkpointed pairing state and honoring turn/context/compaction boundaries.
decisions.rationale: Bounded mirror pairing preserves ordinary repeated messages without adding global content deduplication.

decisions.chose: Use text/role/content-kind allowlists; preserve index-only reads and explicit archive root scopes.
decisions.rationale: Unknown/private scaffolding must not enter searchable evidence, and archive recovery must not silently change the default query scope.

decisions.chose: Publish the same merged SHA through native assets, the Homebrew formula, official website and local package-manager update.
decisions.rationale: Source changes alone do not restore the installed user workflow.

rejected.alternative: Repair only the three observed symptoms with independent heuristics
rejected.reason: A shared parser interpretation marker and stable identity contract prevent the same upgrade and replay faults from recurring.

rejected.alternative: Delete or hand-patch the existing SQLite index
rejected.reason: Scoped sync can replay affected projections while preserving other sources and retained history.

rejected.alternative: Silently re-sync archives into the default user database
rejected.reason: Moving projection file paths into an explicit archive root changes default retrieval scope; archive parsing was validated in a separate test database.

review_notes: Preserved fixed CLI surface, v8 SQLite DELETE/FULL policy, manual sync-only index writes and index-only content reads.
202 library and 13 CLI tests, fmt, clippy -D warnings, release build, 62 npm tests, 27 native contracts and native acceptance passed. PR and main CI plus release archive gates passed.
PR #122 merged at 67713988efe097019a2800a8e2cfc185e6925212; tag v0.5.4 release run 34953845454 succeeded with 7 assets; tap run 34954213418 succeeded and both archive hashes match.
Pages deployment ea12dcd6-1ba9-4ef3-995b-d1682f77b197 serves the same SHA. Homepage, changelog and upgrade content match source bytes; English and Chinese upgrade pages were inspected in browser.

Installed /opt/homebrew/bin/shlog is 0.5.4. Fresh SQLite backup retained; real sync scanned 637 files, updated 634, added 2, had zero errors and wrote complete coverage. Codex now has 6791 sessions/335676 messages, other source counts unchanged, integrity_check=ok; find and returned evidenceRead recovered expected current-format text.

Global skill installed via npx skills add and compared file-for-file to published package. Compressed Codex cold content remains retention-only; broader property/state-machine coverage remains future work already documented.

architectural_claims: Adapter-owned interpretation version controls inventory and reducer validity
Base and segment identities are separate
Mirror pairing state is persisted across append checkpoints
behavioral_changes: Recent response_item/message text becomes searchable user/assistant evidence
First scoped sync replays stale Codex parsers including productive EOF checkpoints
Paginated segments append without changing identity or overwriting parent
Adjacent cross-encoding mirrors appear once while true repetitions are retained
Existing installed users receive native 0.5.4 and a verified repair path

data_model_changes.name: CodexReducerState
data_model_changes.migration_notes: New interpretation and mirror state in private checkpoints; old checkpoint shapes trigger full source replay during explicit sync. SQLite v8 schema is unchanged.

security_implications: Explicit accepted content-kind allowlist excludes injected/private or unknown text content from searchable projection
migration_notes: Old Codex inventory/reducer versions replay on scoped sync; other source projections remain untouched
The local real index was backed up before installed CLI upgrade sync
